_comment: Everything this skill says that is not a number and not a lesson prompt.
Script only — recording happens separately and is not part of a build phase.
`speaksPrompts: false` from the first commit. This skill starts at eight and
a child of eight can read; reading a word problem aloud to them takes the
reading out of the question. Division learned that after recording 74 clips
What it does say is what it says *back* to a child: the reactions, which come
from the common pack and name no subject, and the refusals below — the
sentence an engine gives when it will not take an answer yet.
Phase 0 has no engines. These four are the ones the plan already commits to:
the parts must be equal, the whole must be named, and a fraction of one thing
cannot be compared with a fraction of another.
phrases: The parts have to be the same size.
Half of what? Say what the whole is first.
These are parts of two different things, so you cannot tell.
That is a different amount, not a different name for the same one.
